text: Sunday brunch with four people and not one free table. We stood by the door for 25 minutes and finally left.
Waited 45 minutes for my order on a packed Sunday and then watched it go to another table by mistake. Gave up and left.
Brunch rush meant my order sat at the cafe for an hour before a rider picked it up. Everything cold, all of it limp.
The Sunday crowd swamped the counter and my cappuccino took 22 minutes. Staff looked straight through the queue.
Weekend bheed itni thi ki andar ghuste hi wapas aa gaye. Order hi 40 min mein nahi bana. Worst.
Ninety minute wait in the brunch surge and then the cheesecake slice was missing from the box entirely. Just icing smears.
Line darwaze tak thi, chhe tables aur sau log. Aadha ghanta bheed mein khade rahe, phir bina khaye nikal gaye.
Twelve items for a working lunch showed up two hours late, and three of them were the wrong kind.
I have come every Sunday for a year. Today there was no table, no greeting, and my order was forgotten twice.
Two kids melting down, no space to even stand properly, and our order took 35 minutes. Brunch fail.
Could not hear my friend over the brunch crowd and the rose latte arrived when we were already leaving. Lovely.
Order thanda aur mash ho ke aaya, box bilkul soft tha. Sunday rush mein koi packing ka dhyan nahi.
Full price ki chai aur dustbin ke paas khade ho ke peena pada kyunki ek bhi seat nahi. Weekend mein loot machi hai.
Brunch crowd mein kaam bilkul nahi hua - shor, bheed, babies crying, aur 40 min mein table wapas maang li gayi.
Sunday delivery took over an hour and the cheesecake arrived tilted, glaze pooled on one side. Taste was there, timing was not.
Dopahar ki rush ka shikar - paneer sandwich room temperature pe aaya aur toast chikna ho gaya. Sunday delivery gamble hai.
Kids were starving by the time it landed, 75 minutes late, and everything was barely warm. Sunday delivery is a gamble here.
Counter pe bees log ki line - flat white accha tha par Sunday ki bheed worth nahi kisi coffee ke liye.
Hostel order - cheese toast thanda aur chai room temperature pe aayi. Weekend rush samajh aata hai par 80 min too much.
The drink had tipped inside the carrier and half of it was in the bag instead of the cup. What arrived was warm and half.
Could not take a single call - every table full, noise off the charts, and a queue of people staring at my seat.
Cafe ki line dekh ke hotel pe order kiya. Waffle ek ghante mein aaya aur bilkul soft tha - itne hype ke baad dukh hua.
Sunday batch croissant was borderline stale, like a Saturday leftover. The 6am bake promise felt broken today.
Brunch for the kids arrived 75 minutes after ordering. Fries soft, pasta clumped, everyone grumpy.
Busy Sunday so I ordered in instead. My coffee arrived sloshed over the lid and barely warm - the cafe version is so much better.
Aadha office order hi bag mein nahi tha - chhe cups missing brunch rush mein. Support ne bas sorry bola.
Sunday order reached the PG after 90 minutes, everything cold and the bag crushed. Buddies skipped dinner plans for this.
The rider circled the block for 20 minutes and the chilli cheese toast arrived fused to the paper, lukewarm.
Office pe order kiya - espresso 65 minute mein aaya, aur woh bhi half-filled cup mein. Sunday rush ka bahana sun sun ke thak gaya.
The waffle itself was worth the trip, crisp edges and real maple. The twenty-minute seat hunt beforehand was not.
Bachchon ko shake aur hot chocolate pasand aaya, par stroller rakhne ki jagah nahi thi. Aadha khana khade khaya.
Muffin arrived still warm which was nice, but squashed into one corner of the box like an afterthought.
Surprisingly fast for a packed Sunday - but the croissant was cold and the cappuccino lid popped open in my bag.
Fries ka taste mast tha par delivery tak thande ho gaye. Weekend bheed ke chalte late bhi hua. Overall theek thaak.
Charming little pink place, but packed wall to wall on Sunday and my drink took 25 minutes to reach us.
Brunch chaos mein wifi chhod diya, bas latte peete hue logon ko dekhta raha. Sunday ko kaam ki jagah nahi hai.
Every cup was labelled correctly which saved us, but the whole bag arrived lukewarm after sitting through the lunch rush.
Flat white good as always, but the Sunday brunch crowd changes the whole vibe - loud, rushed, nothing cosy about it.
Delivered on time, to be fair, but everything had steamed itself soggy in the box. Weekends are hard on this place.
Rider was apologetic and sweet, but the pasta was clumped and cool by arrival. Kids ate it anyway, so half points.
Snagged the window seat between crowds - lovely view. The cheesecake was a touch too sweet for me though.
Chai sasti aur acchi hai, par Sunday delivery mein time lagta hai aur thandi ho jaati hai. Manageable.
Order was correct and the cappuccino travelled decently, but the rider waited 25 minutes at the cafe for it. Bad handoff.
Order arrived cold but honestly still tasty enough that I could tell the cafe version must be excellent.
Ordered to the hotel after giving up on the queue. Took a while and one cup leaked, but what survived was genuinely good.
The arrabbiata was too fiery for the kids and staff swapped in rose milk without charging us. Kind, but the wait was long.
Shor ne saari calls maar di, phir email pe shift hua aur cold brew ne sambhala. Sunday work session ke liye nahi.
Pickup itself was quick, but they forgot the muffin in the bag and I noticed only at home. Check before you hand over, pls.
Chai hostel tak garam pahunchi par ek ghanta laga. Weekend ke liye itna wait normal ho gaya hai shayad.
Brunch at home instead: the cheesecake was still chilled and lovely, just a very small slice for 290 plus delivery.
Bags were packed and ready when I arrived in the Sunday rush - except one label did not match what was inside.
The order tasted great but the portion is small and delivery made it pricey for what reached my plate.
Ordered in after we could not get a table. Food was lukewarm and one box was dented, but nothing actually spilled.
Busy Sunday brunch but so worth it - the waffle had proper crisp edges. Only wish the tables turned over a bit calmer.
Staff found us a corner for four amid the brunch madness and kept the kids' food coming fast. Slightly loud, all good.
Arrived still warm despite the brunch rush clogging everything. Sandwich was toasted right, just ten minutes slower than ideal.
Sunday bheed mein bhi kulhad chai jaldi bana di. 140 ka chai aur free window seat - bura nahi hai yaar.
Out in six minutes despite a queue to the door. Cappuccino solid as ever. Weekend counter team is a machine.
Loud, yes, but the wifi held and the cold brew was excellent. Managed two hours of work between the brunch waves.
Fifteen drinks, all labelled, one small delay in the Sunday surge. The office remains loyal.
Braved the brunch queue and the filter coffee in the dabarah was worth every minute of it. Crowded but alive.
My usual corner was taken but the flat white was the same as ever. Weekend rush does not shake this kitchen.
Shake came thick and cold, lid taped down so nothing spilled in the chaos. Happy brunch-at-home.
Skipped the Sunday crowd and ordered the rose latte home. Packed carefully, still fragrant. Wish the cup was bigger.
Quick snack run between plans - hot, salted, peri-peri on point, and cheap enough to not feel guilty.
Kids demolished the waffle and shake. Mild wait at peak brunch but staff warned us upfront, which helps.
Dessert survived a busy Sunday delivery intact, glaze glossy. Box corner dented but the slice was perfect.
The flap board clicking over mid-rush is good theatre and my espresso came fast. Packed, but efficiently so.
Great playlist, gorgeous light on the pink walls, and the seat hunt took only ten minutes. Sunday done right.
Picked up twelve labelled sandwiches in the middle of brunch chaos - every one correct, bag easy to carry.
Heaving with people yet staff stayed cheerful and steered me to the avocado toast and chai. Worth the squeeze.
Sunday ritual intact: warm cinnamon roll, icing not melted, out the door in five. The crowd respects regulars' pace.
Fries arrived with crunch intact thanks to a vented box, even on the busiest delivery slot. Peri-peri still dusted right.
Cheese toast aur chai hostel tak theek se aaye, Sunday rush ke baad bhi garam. Thoda late but paisa vasool.
Found the one corner plug amid the brunch chaos and nursed a cappuccino for two hours. Loud but survivable.
Ordered in after failing to get a table - pasta still warm, hot chocolate unspilled, kids satisfied. Good save.
Queue looked scary but moved fast - in and out in under ten minutes on a Sunday. Drink was fine, system impressive.
Waffle, dhoop, aur Sunday ka crowd dekhna - achha laga. Bas table ke liye jaldi aana padta hai.
Grabbed a blueberry muffin to go since no table was free - still warm, berries bursting, happy accident.
Gave up on tables and got it delivered to the park-side bench instead. Everything arrived together and reasonably warm.
Bheed ke baad bhi corner seat mil gayi, iced latte sahi tha. Sunday crowd mein survive kar liya - win.
Latte had cooled a notch by arrival but the delivery itself was fast for a Sunday lunch slot. Fair trade.
Big team order survived the weekend surge - all cups labelled, all accounted for, still warm enough.
Zoya spotted me in the brunch crowd and held a table for two minutes while I ordered. That is why I keep coming.
The cheesecake is worth braving the Sunday crowd - burnt basque edges, real strawberries. Slightly hectic room, great plate.
Counter churned through the rush like a production line. Impressive to watch, coffee in hand within minutes.
Waffle, maple, berries and a full house humming around us - brunch heaven. This is the place I describe to friends.
Shakes for the kids, fries for the table, and staff who smiled through the Sunday madness. We will be back.
Sunday funday - chai, cheese toast, dost, aur corner seat. Itni bheed mein bhi vibe hi alag hai. Paisa vasool.
Beat the brunch crowd by ten minutes - flat white ready fast, silky as ever. Perfect start to a Sunday.
Sunday lunch delivered hot and on time in the middle of the brunch rush. Pasta still fiery, cheese still melted.
Best waffle of my entire Bengaluru trip, eaten elbow to elbow with happy strangers. The crowd tells you everything.
Meera saved my corner table before the rush hit and had the cappuccino waiting. A year of Sundays, still perfect.
Even on Sunday I found a quiet-ish corner, and the cold brew with the orange twist kept me going all afternoon.
Rose latte, shared waffle, sunshine through the pink windows - the Sunday I will be thinking about on Monday.
They joined two tables for our four without a flicker of fuss, right in the middle of the brunch rush. Felt looked after.
Hostel brunch delivered - fries crispy, chai garam, total bill budget-friendly. Sunday sorted without leaving the room.
Eighteen items for the team, every label right, all delivered inside the window despite the weekend surge. Flawless.
Cinnamon roll arrived warm with the icing in a separate pot so I could drizzle it myself. Weekend luxury, delivered.
Even with a full house my takeaway cappuccino was in hand in five minutes. Ritual intact, Sunday saved.
The flap board flipping mid-brunch, hot chocolate with marshmallows, and nowhere to be. Little joys.
Bachche khush, waffle mast, shake thick. Weekend bheed ke baad bhi staff ne sab handle kiya. Perfect family spot.
Kulhad chai in a pink cafe full of Sunday chatter - staff even explained the menu to a clueless visitor. Loved it.
Rider was quick, the paneer sandwich was still hot, mint chutney packed on the side. Brunch without the queue.
Croissant still warm from the morning bake even at 11 on a Sunday. In and out fast, happy as always.
Three of us split the bill, found seats after a short wait, and stayed an hour for less than a movie ticket.
Strawberry cheesecake and slow Sunday jazz - the glaze alone is worth the wait for a table.
Staff were endlessly patient with two restless kids and still got our order out fast. Rare combination.
Surprised myself by finishing a chapter here on a Sunday. Corner seat, cold brew, tolerable noise. Good place.
Espresso at the counter in three minutes even with the brunch line. Small cafe, big efficiency.
Pink walls, the flap board, the smell of fresh bakes - and a drink I finished too fast because it was that good.
Seamless pickup in the middle of the weekend rush - ten filter coffees and sandwiches, all labelled, ready on time.
Hot chocolate arrived intact and actually hot, marshmallows packed separately so they stayed pillowy. Brunch goals.
Full paisa vasool brunch - fries, cheese toast, doston ki bheed, aur corner table. Budget mein best Sunday.
The waffle box has a little steam vent so it reached me crisp, maple in a pot on the side. Genius packing.
Kabir did a tulip pour on my flat white even with the queue snaking out the door. Craft does not take Sundays off.
Asked for the pasta less spicy for the kids via the order note and it came exactly right, still hot. Thoughtful kitchen.
In and out in three minutes flat on a packed Sunday. The counter team here could teach speed to anyone.
Hidden gem confirmed - filter coffee frothed properly, a happy brunch crowd, and photos that needed no filter.
Best Sunday brunch spot for a family in Indiranagar. Warm staff, happy kids, worth every bit of the crowd.
